description.value: A village-run campground right on the Kettle River in downtown Midway, with flush toilets, showers, and a dedicated cyclist shelter; just blocks south of Highway 3 with full town amenities within walking distance.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at midwaybc.ca/campground/ is fetched and current, providing direct confirmation of amenities via a 'Quick Facts' list that explicitly names showers, flush toilets, 11 sites (8 with 15 amp power), a group site, and a 'Cyclist shelter.' The OSM phone (+1-250-449-2467) does not appear on the campground page — the booking contact given is 250-449-1053 (Memory Delisle) — and the OSM email (stewartstemon@yahoo.com) differs from the website's campinginmidway@gmail.com, both flagged as discrepancies. Food and services within walking distance of the village are confirmed on the separate amenities page, and the website's 2025–2026 posts confirm the business is actively operating.
concerns: Phone discrepancy: OSM lists +1-250-449-2467 but the campground booking contact on the website is 250-449-1053 (Memory Delisle); the OSM number may be an outdated or unrelated Village Office line.
Email discrepancy: OSM lists stewartstemon@yahoo.com but the website lists campinginmidway@gmail.com as the current campground booking email.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Municipal campground with an explicit cyclist shelter, showers, electrical hookups, and a riverside location in the heart of Midway directly on the Highway 3 corridor — a clear and useful listing for touring cyclists.

wow_evidence: Quick Facts list that explicitly names a 'Cyclist shelter'
